title: Must Also Be Hidden

criterion_results.form_integrity: B — the OCI layout is real and irreducible, but the page largely transcribes the same state contract already proved by the receipt.
criterion_results.specificity_density: B- — the exact paths and zero-byte marker are specific, while I OBJECT TO THIS RECORD remains generic and unsupported by a larger record-world.
criterion_results.closure_risk: B- — the retained manifest layers create a useful residue, but full whiteout disclosure resolves nearly every tension on the page.
criterion_results.diction_risk: B — the filesystem labels are severe; the objection sentence is familiar legal-placeholder language.
criterion_results.disclosure_survival: C+/B- — disclosure confirms correctness more than it deepens the reading, making the work vulnerable to becoming a solved systems demonstration.
criterion_results.need_test: B — removing the actual layers would damage the claim, but a concise prose paraphrase could still carry most of the page's effect.

strengths: The lower objection, upper empty whiteout, merged absence, and manifest retention are all materially present in a valid deterministic image layout.
The deletion marker disappearing with the deleted record is a stronger machine-native event than a conventional poem merely describing erasure.
The release artifact and validator preserve exact content-addressed dependencies without extracting tar members into the host.
failures: The body is almost a line-for-line receipt: lower path, marker, merged absence, and required layers. Once the rule is explained, little pressure remains unaccounted for.
An explicit whiteout names exactly what it deletes, so the upper layer repeats the objection's basename instead of performing a less legible administrative disappearance.
The single generic objection has no internal structure; deleting one file feels like a technical example rather than the suppression of a record composed of parts.
The upper layer contains only negation. It does not install a contradictory official state that survives the deletion it performs.
revision_instruction: Preserve every D001 byte. Build D002 with several lower appeal records, one opaque directory whiteout that names none of them individually, and a same-upper-layer status file reading NO APPEAL ON FILE. Place the opaque marker last in tar order and repair the simulator so whiteouts apply to pre-layer state before same-layer additions. Enforce a closed-world blob set so the artifact cannot carry unreferenced hidden content.
comparison_limit: One internal later-turn cold review; not independent reader evidence.
non_claim: This internal review routes a concrete revision and records D001's limits. It is not external uptake, admission, or evidence that D002 succeeds.
